title: Tunisian Cheese Tagine
description: A North African-inspired casserole with a rich blend of spices and melted cheese.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced red pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the Tunisian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a tagine dish or a 9x13 inch casserole.
Top with the shredded cheese and drizzle with the cheese sauce.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with rosemary sprigs and serve hot.
